evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce CocoonBench, a benchmark that evaluates whether multilingual search agents can escape such language information cocoons.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Using language-specific entity names, it records each task's minimum language cover, removes direct identifiers, and renders each task as matched prompts in three languages together with its construction certificate and provenance.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across 10 state-of-the-art models, mean accuracy on CocoonBench ranges from 33.8% (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) to 69.7% (Claude-Opus-4.8), leaving even the strongest system below 70%.
